sources.title: Research Problems in Function Theory (New Edition)
sources.manuscript_status: arXiv draft v2, 21 September 2018; later publication is a different edition
sources.inspection: PDF page 40 (printed page 39), Problem and Update 2.42 visually inspected; reference [61] read from extracted bibliography. Direct redownload matched the locally available copy.
supports: Definition and two-part scope of Problem 2.42
Attribution to Barsegyan of the entire sum <= 1 and meromorphic sum <= 2 bounds
limits: The update reports a result; it does not contain Barsegyan's proof.
The Barsegyan citation has a venue discrepancy.

sources.title: On asymptotic curves of entire functions of finite order
sources.manuscript_status: Published English translation: Math. USSR-Sbornik 37(4) (1980), 509-533; Russian original 1979
sources.inspection: Author-hosted PDF downloaded; PDF pages 23-24 (printed 531-532), Section 3, equations (3.5)-(3.9), read in text and visually inspected. Math-Net metadata independently checked.
supports: Prior attribution of the positive construction
Formula, rotational symmetry, asymptotic values, ray count, total count, and ratio 1/(2n)
limits: This 1980 paper expressly leaves the simultaneous density-one question open; it is not a source for the later Barsegyan bound.
